summary.headline: Nativity Calculations and Planetary Places
summary.text: Astrological nativity calculations using Egyptian calendar dates, epochs, stations, and zodiacal release, yielding Venus in Pisces, Sagittarius, and Capricorn and a star in Aquarius. A list assigns good, bad, or irregular places to the Sun, Moon, Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Venus, and Mercury, with reference to Firmicus and the efficacy of the seven stars in twelve places.
